newsitem.title: OMAN: Oman Alliance Housing Bank offers shares to public.
newsitem.headline: Oman Alliance Housing Bank offers shares to public.

text.p: Oman's Alliance Housing Bank SAOG said on Saturday it was offering eight million shares for public subscription with immediate effect.

"The founder members of Alliance Housing Bank SAOG (under formation) offer to the general public the opportunity to invest in the first private specialist housing bank in the Sultanate of Oman," it said in a notice published in The Observer daily.
The notice said the share capital open for subscription was 20 million shares, with 12 million shares subscribed for by founder members.
"Non-Omani nationals may subscribe for shares up to a maximum of 49 percent of the bank's issued share capital," it said.
Nominal share value would be one rial each, with an issue price of 1.020 rials including issue expenses.
The issue period closes on May 4, the bank said.
